value.title: PR 289: terminal-state polling and review proof

sections.name: body
sections.value:
#289 review at 844d2fd697604ecbba1b489be3dd8d5a23d75741.

R273's added Closed branch was unreachable: role_request reads only role_requests, while closing moves the row to closed_role_requests. The branch-removal mutant survived; a real-store probe verified None from the open lookup, Closed from the closed lookup, and no subsequent delivery transition. Logged as C34 follow-up R289-FU-01. Check the lookup's actual table before claiming a terminal-state poll is covered.

F235 is state-driven but retains scaled stall watchdogs. with_stage_limit is a public builder used only by a test, not a cfg(test) API; the four-second production default remains unchanged. Ten focused mutants were killed.

Magic wand: a dependency-free review gate that imports exact-head CI receipts and runs scoped local Rust proofs. Difficulty: C25 forbids dependency links, yet boot proposes worktree-deps and the full gate spends a workspace run before reporting unavailable TS tools. Shared-build contention then delayed the mutation matrix. Keep the lock; coordinate a slot rather than bypassing it.

The exact CI JUnit receipt came from successful job 136239808448, artifact ID 14622517042, not a name-only download. Head intake was FINAL; main advanced during the review and the latest pr-freeze reported DIRTY. Holding remains until merge.
